title: Multi-directory workspace support for UI-triggered processes
description: When the UI app triggers a new process or runs process-continue, the spawned Claude Code session should support attaching multiple directories (workspaces) via --add-dir. This allows processes to operate across multiple codebases simultaneously - e.g., a process that needs access to both the main repo and a shared library. The UI should let users configure which directories to attach per process or template.
author: matanha@payoneer.com
